# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 51 — The EMET Bible (Literal)

**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 39-40 | **Source Image:** source-texts/coptic/GTH_051_page_001.jpg

---

## Saying 51

**1** His disciples said to him: "When will the rest [мтон] for the dead [нетмооут] come, and when will the new world [космос нвреш] arrive?"

**2** He said to them: "What you are looking for has already come, but you do not know it."

---

**Textual Notes (EMET):**
- *мтон*: rest/repose — same word as Saying 50's "repose"; the disciples ask about eschatological rest
- *нетмооут*: the dead
- *космос нвреш*: new world/cosmos; *нвреш* = new
- "Has already come" — the realized eschatology; the new world and the rest are present realities
- The disciples ask about the future; Jesus points to the present
- cf. Luke 17:20-21: "The kingdom of God is not coming with signs to be observed... the kingdom of God is in the midst of you"
